Overview

Mae Sot is a city in Tak with a population of 40,000. A border town on the Myanmar frontier, a major hub for cross-border trade and refugee services, known for its diverse cultures and nearby waterfalls. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
